public_nodes.title: What is a CSV file?
public_nodes.body: A CSV (comma-separated values) file stores tabular data as plain text. Each row is a record; fields within a row are separated by commas. CSV files can be opened in any spreadsheet application.

public_nodes.title: Difference between text and number data types
public_nodes.body: Numeric cells support arithmetic; text cells do not. Dates stored as text cannot be sorted chronologically. Always check the data type before calculating totals.

public_nodes.title: What is a pivot table?
public_nodes.body: A pivot table summarises rows by grouping and aggregating (sum, count, average). It lets you quickly explore large datasets without writing formulas.
